title: 宝塚記念の後に・受け取ったバトン

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Both Kitasan Black and Brusquement run in their own styles as they push themselves to their absolute limits, pouring everything they have into the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And now, they finally get the closure they never found in the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, we learn that Brusquement has been injured. Kitasan Black is entrusted with her rival's aspirations as well and sets her sights on the autumn Tenno Sho!
